breakpoints.note: The ClientHello parser accepts the raw extensions block and materializes `clienthello->pre_proc_exts`, so later resumption logic can index `TLSEXT_IDX_session_ticket` instead of rejecting the handshake earlier.

First project-side materialization of the vulnerability-relevant input. The built-in extension table entry at `extensions.c:203-208` is `TLSEXT_TYPE_session_ticket`, and `tls_collect_extensions()` stores that raw extension body into the matching `RAW_EXTENSION` slot later reached as `hello->pre_proc_exts[TLSEXT_IDX_session_ticket]`.

The staged patch inserts `sess = NULL;` immediately after this free. That makes the later `*psess = sess;` publish `NULL` instead of a freed pointer, so `ssl_get_prev_session()` takes its `ret == NULL` path instead of dereferencing stale memory.
